solves.reasoning: (A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: executive(A=____, 원문 executive) — forth(B=forth, 'back and forth') — different(C=different, 'completely different'). det: ①executive/forth/different 정답.
(A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: nonlinear(A, 'nonlinear system') — orderly(B, 'quite orderly fashion') — generated(C, 'generated by iteration'). det: ③nonlinear/orderly/generated 정답.
(A)(B)(C) 원문 대조: beyond(A, 'pushed beyond a certain point') — chaotic(B, 'pattern is chaotic') — entirely(C, 'entirely different set'). det: ②beyond/chaotic/entirely 정답.
마커 원문대조: ④"similar" ≠ 원문"different". 혼돈 시스템에서는 동일 초기조건에서도 '완전히 다른(different)' 결과. similar(유사한)는 반대.
마커 원문대조: ②"disorderly" ≠ 원문"orderly". 분기점 이전에는 '질서정연하게(orderly)' 행동함. disorderly(무질서한)는 반대.
마커 원문대조: ④"prevents" ≠ 원문"leads to". 'not all iteration leads to chaos' — 반복이 항상 혼돈으로 '이끌지'는 않는다. prevents(방지하다)는 반대.
빈칸 원문대조: "chaotic" — 'In fact, the pattern of its movement is chaotic'. 선지 ④chaotic.
빈칸 원문대조: "orderly" — 'they may behave in a quite orderly fashion'. 선지 ①orderly.
빈칸 원문대조: "bifurcation" — 'pushed beyond a certain point, called a bifurcation'. 선지 ①bifurcation.
arranged의 동의어. arranged = 배열된. ch=[scattered, positioned, removed, stacked] → ②positioned(배치된).
reached의 동의어. reached = 도달된. ch=[avoided, exceeded, attained, created] → ③attained(달성된).
generated의 동의어. generated = 생성된. ch=[prevented, predicted, preserved, produced] → ④produced(생성됨).
orderly의 반의어. orderly = 질서정연한. ch=[chaotic, systematic, regular, calm] → ①chaotic(혼돈스러운)이 반의어.
chaotic의 반의어. chaotic = 혼돈스러운. ch=[turbulent, predictable, dynamic, unstable] → ③predictable(예측 가능한)이 반의어.
(A) 'in a quite orderly fashion' = 방식(manner/way). (B) 'fashion' 문맥 → 유행. 두 의미 다름. ch ④'(A)방식 – (B)유행'.
반복 과정을 설명하는 영영풀이 → iteration(반복). ch=[bifurcation, oscillation, fluctuation, iteration] → ③iteration.
어형변환: chaos(명사) → chaotic(형용사). 'the pattern of its movement is _____(chaos)' → chaotic.
어형변환: order(명사) → orderly(형용사). 'they may behave in a quite _____(order) fashion' → orderly.
빈칸 원문대조: "become" — 'it will become completely different'. ch에서 ②'become completely various'가 blank=become에 해당. → ②=2.
빈칸 원문대조: "not all iteration leads to chaos" — 'Chaotic systems are generated by iteration, though not all iteration leads to chaos'. 선지 ①'not all iteration leads to chaos'.
